build.buildCommand: npm install && cp packages/backend/prisma/schema.postgresql.prisma packages/backend/prisma/schema.prisma && npx prisma generate --schema=packages/backend/prisma/schema.prisma && npm run build --workspace=packages/backend && npm run build --workspace=packages/bot

deploy.startCommand: npx prisma db push --schema=packages/backend/prisma/schema.prisma --accept-data-loss && node packages/backend/dist/index.js & node packages/bot/dist/index.js
